sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: In this unit, use first-person forms such as felkelek, reggelizek, dolgozom and tanulok to talk about your own routine.

items.english: I get up in the morning.
I have breakfast in the morning.

sections.content: Notice dolgozom, not dolgozok, for "I work." dolgozik is an "ik-verb" — a small class that takes -om/-em/-öm instead of the usual -ok/-ek/-ök in the first person. There are only a couple of dozen common ik-verbs, so you'll meet the same handful again and again rather than a huge list to memorise.
